<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the forward DIBAL‑H reduction of a carboxylic ester to an aldehyde/alcohol, i.e., breaking a carboxylic ester and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl (C–O bond order change 2→1). Use the product SMILES from the previous step as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C-O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
